Name: TID_FACTION_11_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: \qOi mate, you took a wrong turn there. Time to pay the road toll.\q

Name: TID_FACTION_11_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: Simple thugs who believe in the law of the jungle, Hooligans pose a serious danger when grouped up.

Name: TID_FACTION_11_DESCRIPTION_2
Text: Hooligans are highly unstable and prone to senseless violence due to their heavy drinking and drug use.

Name: TID_FACTION_15_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: \qWhat you looking at ese? You wanna get dropped?\q

Name: TID_FACTION_15_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: The Diablos are real Old School. Their gang traditions are built on 20th century TV and movies.

Name: TID_FACTION_22_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: \qIt's time for a feast. Will you join me for dinner?\q

Name: TID_FACTION_22_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: \qYou know what they say - the rich eat the poor!\q

Name: TID_FACTION_22_DESCRIPTION_2
Text: These predatory businessmen have found a new kind of thrill.

Name: TID_FACTION_10_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: \qLook, forget about the Suits. Without us nothing moves on or off these islands.\q

Name: TID_FACTION_10_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: Dawnbreak's dockworkers have organized into a strong union, largely independent of Labycore.

Name: TID_FACTION_10_DESCRIPTION_2
Text: The Dockers are fiercely protective of their turf, overtime benefits and professional pride.

Name: TID_FACTION_18_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: \qAhh, you are such a lovely little thing. I want to chain you to the wall and let some freak whip you for money!\q

Name: TID_FACTION_18_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: You don't have to be a sadist to smuggle, pimp and brutalize girls, but it helps.

Name: TID_FACTION_18_DESCRIPTION_2
Text: Prostitution and slave trade can always use people who speak the victims' language.

Name: TID_FACTION_19_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: \qHired Guns... they are flies attracted to the stench of blood, gold and cordite.\q

Name: TID_FACTION_19_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: \qWhat, I'm one of the bad guys? Don't be ridiculous, I just work here!\q

Name: TID_FACTION_19_DESCRIPTION_2
Text: Private security contracting is a growth business, which has led to a rather variable quality of services offered.

Name: TID_FACTION_17_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: \qHalt, citizen! I am authorized to use extreme force.\q

Name: TID_FACTION_17_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: \qRaise your hands above your head and prepare for summary execution.\q

Name: TID_FACTION_17_DESCRIPTION_2
Text: Behind their armor, Labycore Troopers are in fact human beings - despite their cyborg-like appearance and emotional capacity.

Name: TID_FACTION_12_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: \qWhy work your way from money to power to women, when you can bring in all of them at once aboard a nice ship?\q

Name: TID_FACTION_12_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: \qWe just supply what people want. Of course we also tell them what it is they want.\q

Name: TID_FACTION_12_DESCRIPTION_2
Text: The Mad Dogs are a well-organized and equipped gang connected to many different criminal activities.

Name: TID_FACTION_12_DESCRIPTION_3
Text: Smuggling contraband under the nose of corrupt port authorities, Mad Dogs have drawn the ire of Dockers.

Name: TID_FACTION_27_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: \qThere will always be doubters and naysayers, people who don't believe in progress and human achievement.\q\n-Sid Lovens

Name: TID_FACTION_27_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: More of Dawnbreak's outcasts join the Resistance every day. What they lack is high tech weapons and equipment needed to challenge Labycore.

Name: TID_FACTION_21_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: Fresh off the boat, these cultists live on the fringes of Dawnbreak and practice their native tradition.

Name: TID_FACTION_5_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: \qThe bitch gave me lip so I swelled it up for him.\q

Name: TID_FACTION_5_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: \qWe both have guns but I make this one look sexy.\q

Name: TID_FACTION_5_DESCRIPTION_2
Text: Dawnbreak's original all-girl gang, Valkyries redefine \qviolent feminism\q.

Name: TID_FACTION_28_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: Labycore's crown jewel, a land of opportunity and adventure!

Name: TID_FACTION_31_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: Muties, cavemen, abominations - people have come up with various names for them. Mutants themselves prefer to be called the New Breed.

Name: TID_FACTION_31_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: The Green Monsters of Paradise Island are rumored to be intelligent and communicative. Their red-skinned brethren roam the deserts and city sewers, attacking anyone they see.

Name: TID_FACTION_31_DESCRIPTION_2
Text: The cause of aggressive mutations on Paradise Island is shrouded in mystery.

Name: TID_FACTION_31_DESCRIPTION_3
Text: Legend tells of a green cloud enveloping Sunny Lagoon holiday resort, followed by a gruesome transmogrification of its inhabitants.

Name: TID_FACTION_31_DESCRIPTION_4
Text: \qTread lightly on New Breed territory, little human.\q

Name: TID_FACTION_29_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: Bloodthirsty bands of Raiders roam the deserts of Paradise Island.

Name: TID_FACTION_29_DESCRIPTION_2
Text: The Raiders do some trading with the Mad Dogs and Eastern Queens, mostly to satisfy their depraved pleasures.

Name: TID_FACTION_37_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: \qYou have just arrived on Dawnbreak in search of a better life.\q

Name: TID_FACTION_38_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: \qYou have to escape before Labycore cuts up your brain!\q

Name: TID_FACTION_39_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: \qGrim Gonzales stands between you and freedom.\q

Name: TID_FACTION_40_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: \qDEFOE is a heavily armed Walker Mech. Good thing it's on your side!\q
